question: How does contemplating smoke-colored form always shake the triple world, O beloved?
premises: trailokyaṃ cālayet means shakes triple world
inference: Contemplating smoke-colored form always shakes the triple world.
uncertainties: whether dhūmra varṇaṃ is object of cintya or cālayet
plain_english: Contemplating smoke-colored form always shakes the triple world, O beloved.
